relevant_laws.quote: A vehicle must not be driven to the left side of the highway at any time: When approaching within 100 feet or traversing any intersection or railroad grade crossing. Subsection 2 does not apply upon a one-way highway.
relevant_laws.relevance_type: left-side driving within 100 feet of or traversing a railroad grade crossing, with one-way exception
relevant_laws.notes: Actual highway, railroad and grade-crossing qualification need original source and physical review.
